result.limitation: Small isolated local fixture; selected-point RPO/RTO, not production SLO or remote storage test

scenario_table.latency_scope: All first attempts, including expected 409 conflicts.
scenario_table.rate_scope: Across mixed phases, including phase spacing and write throttling; not a constant 1000 RPS gate.
scenario_table.goodput_scope: Validated HTTP calls excluding duplicate receipts.

scenario_table.rate_scope: Original probe records call-start only; header-start unmeasured.

notes: Final HEAD is measured independently; e3 byte equivalence does not substitute for actual CI.

CI collection is read-only: this collector did not rerun jobs or change application branches/workflows. The parent-authorized PITR retry is retained as a separate attempt; later audit-only archival does not promote any gate.
Every raw failure and any earlier failed attempt are retained; completed requests are not synonymous with valid successes.
The 600-second probe does not execute a multi-hour production target; preserve NOT_EXECUTED.
HTTPcore header-start is not packet capture or proof of server acceptance; the stability probe does not measure header starts.
Generated fixed-world workload with no actual model calls; no combined API/derived-worker scale experiment.
Signing-key download failures occur before recovery and cannot be called successful PITR.
Mixed benchmark git_dirty includes its prewritten source snapshot; snapshot bytes and recorded checkout tree are checked separately.

runtime_byte_equivalence.limitation: Byte-equivalent application/workflow/benchmark inputs do not predeclare final HEAD CI or capacity as passing.

limitations: Read-only overload; mixed business commits are measured by p2_behavioral_load
Wire-start trace observes HTTP header send start, not packet capture or server acceptance
Schema validation runs after network timing but every success requires it
Shared host; short window does not establish sustained production SLO
Synthetic small world; fixed historical reads, no model requests
Process crash/receipt recovery is a separate integration test
No claim of hosted Agent products being integrated
One-hour minimum long-duration label is an explicit probe convention, not a production SLO
